implementation.rationale: A three-way merge of two skill files, one ported script and its tests need one sequential coding worker.

planning.rationale: A fresh non-author session reviews the criteria and checks before the build.
planning.scope: Criteria review of plan.md and checks.md

verification.rationale: No risk area is touched, so the ordinary fresh Verifier covers the full feature range.
verification.scope: Every check over the feature base to HEAD
